svg.title: SKYWATCH — Complete system flow: camera feed to on-scene resolution
svg.desc: Full end-to-end flow: video input through YOLO detection, multi-agent LangGraph pipeline, FSM/MCDM scoring, Firebase upload, Haversine dispatch with cascade fallback, mobile app auth, alert acceptance, navigation with IoV broadcast, admin dashboard realtime tracking, and final case resolution.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What video sources does SKYWATCH support?')
g.text: Live stream or file — with lat/long metadata

sendPrompt('How does fire and smoke detection work?')
sendPrompt('What does the PerceptionAgent do?')
g.text: Aggregates raw detections from all modules

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do Kalman filter and EMA smooth detections?')
g.text: Kalman filter + EMA — reduces false positives
